industry: quick-service restaurant equipment (beverage, cooking, ice, refrigeration, HVAC)
self_fix_allowed: replacing an empty bag-in-box syrup bag
checking that a CO2 tank valve is open and the gauge isn't in the red
checking ice levels in ice bins and dispensers
checking power plugs and resetting a tripped breaker once
checking that cooler and freezer doors close and seal and nothing blocks them
rinsing or replacing tool-free air filters (ice machine front filter, HVAC return-air filter)
self_fix_forbidden: adjusting any gas valve or CO2 regulator, or relighting a gas pilot
opening any panel or cover that needs a tool
any electrical work beyond resetting a breaker once
handling hot oil outside the normal filtering routine
safety_topics: gas leaks: if anyone smells gas, don't touch switches or flames, get everyone out, and call the gas company
hot oil: burns and fire; never put water on an oil fire; let fryers cool before any work
CO2 asphyxiation in enclosed spaces: if a CO2 leak is suspected (hissing, headache, dizziness), ventilate and leave the area
high-pressure gas: never loosen fittings on a pressurized CO2 line
water near electrical parts: unplug before touching wet areas around equipment
food safety: coolers must hold 41 degrees F or below; move and log food when a cooler runs warm
sanitation: mold in nozzles, ice bins, or ice machines is a health hazard; sanitize before serving
roof access and falls: only technicians go on the roof
